name: VA HOME ADMIN 2.0
changes: Rebuilds the VA HOME back-office around a dedicated operations workspace inspired by the proven VAcleaner admin UX
Adds Overview, Needs Attention, Customers, Catalog, Marketing, Payments and Settings without removing existing order, review, promo, release or analytics workflows
Adds global admin search across orders, customers, fragrances, promo codes and reviews
Adds manual order creation for Instagram, phone and offline orders through the existing validated create-order pipeline
Adds mobile/PWA bottom navigation and a compact More menu
notes: VAcleaner v3.0.39 is used only as a UX/UI reference; VA HOME does not consume VAcleaner tables, Edge Functions or booking logic.
No new production database migration or Edge Function deployment is required for Admin 2.0.
The storefront, checkout, Monobank payment boundary, cart, search and personal-care flows remain on the v16.2.7 functional baseline.
